title: Heidenhain DIN/ISO post writes Q395 and Q208 in cycles 200/205, which iTNC 530 NC 340 49x does not accept

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

`assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:744-747`:
- G200 writes `Q395=+0`.
- G205 writes `Q379`, `Q253`, `Q208=+99999.999` and `Q395`.

## Which versions accept which parameters

From HEIDENHAIN's own change lists and cycle manuals:

- **Q379, Q253** (cycle 205): from iTNC 530 NC 340 422, TNC 640 -01, TNC 620 340 56x-01, TNC 320 34055x-06. **Valid on 340 490.**
- **Q208** (cycle 205) and **Q395** (cycles 200 and 205): only from iTNC 530 **60642x-04**, TNC 640 34059x-04, TNC 620 81760x-01, TNC 320 77185x-05 (Q395 in cycle 200: 77185x-01). Source: "Cycle 205: Input parameter Q208 for retraction feed rate added" (iTNC 530 manual 670388-25, p. 13; 737759-24, p. 20).

So the post's G200 and G205 blocks are not valid on any iTNC 530 340 49x software. This includes the Fehlmann Picomax 55 (NC 340490-03). The programming station used in #3095 runs 606425-04, which is why it accepted the blocks.

Note: the iTNC 60642x-04 change list names the depth reference "Q359", but the example blocks of the same manuals show `Q395`. This is probably a typo in the list.

## Expected

- For iTNC 530 340 49x (and other controls before the versions above), write G200 without Q395, and G205 without Q208 and Q395.
- The control's dwell or retract defaults then apply, or the post refuses a requested behaviour that the old cycle cannot do, by name.
- The choice follows the control and NC software in the machine file (see the dialect issue filed with this one).

## Done means

- G200 and G205 for an iTNC 530 340 49x machine contain only the parameters of that software.
- A test pins both parameter sets.
- The changed goldens are listed in the PR.

Related: #3095.
